top_signals.title: Asian Airlines Face a $148-a-Barrel Fuel Gamble
top_signals.summary: Asian airlines are facing expiring jet fuel hedge contracts and need to make a choice about whether to hedge at exorbitant prices or risk them going even higher without a hedge. Citing industry executives, Reuters reported today that jet fuel prices in Asia are currently about 75% higher than they were before the war in the Middle East started, and that the chance of that changing dramatically in the observable future appears to be slim. “Our view is that we are facing a new normal where the fuel price is there to stay at the levels that…
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Exclusive: Taiwan to review security advice for AI execs following Huang affairs
top_signals.summary: Taiwan is reviewing security advice for senior figures in its AI sector following Jensen Huang’s dramatic downfall, as new reports of a third extramarital affair deepen the scandal surrounding Nvidia’s former chief executive.
